rows.title: Grocery pickup
rows.why_now: Walmart is piloting the use of storage and retrieval robotics, dubbed Alphabot, to increase the speed of online grocery order pickup, according to blog post .

quotes.site: The technology, which was developed in collaboration between Walmart and startup Alert Innovation, is being installed in a 20,000 square foot extension of a Salem, New Hampshire supercenter, which will also be a dedicated pickup point for groceries.
quotes.deadline: Walmart said it will be operational by the end of this year, while regular grocery pickup will begin at the store on Oct.
